{{Event Infobox
| Name  = Old Beggar
| Image = Event-Beggar.png
}}
{{E|Old Beggar}} is an [[Event]] found exclusively in [[Act 2]]. It will only appear if the player has at least 75 [[Gold]].

== Options ==
{{Frame|Offer Gold}} {{TS|gold||75 [[Gold]]:}} {{TS|positive||Remove a card from your deck.}} 
<br>
<br>
{{Frame|Leave}} Nothing happens.

== Dialogue ==
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
An old beggar cloaked in fur reaches his hands out towards you as you pass. "Spare some coin, child?"
</div><br><br>

{{Frame|Offer Gold}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
The beggar takes off its cloak to reveal that he is {{TS|blue||Cleric!}} <br>
{{TS||shake|"You are a kind soul. Receive my purification!"}} he screams. <br>
You are unsure if he is grateful or mad.
</div><br><br>
{{Frame|Leave}}
<blockquote>
If the player returns from the Map screen instead of progressing to the next floor, the event has extra dialogue:
<div style="font-style:italic"><br><br>
{{TS||shake|"I hope you do better this time, friend!"}} he shouts.
<br>
Wondering what was implied by this, you push forward.
</div></blockquote></blockquote>

{{Frame|Leave}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
The beggar looks to the floor as you pass. <br>
"You will never make a difference... You never do."
</div></blockquote>
</blockquote>

== Trivia ==
* Cleric is also encountered in {{E|The Cleric}} event.
* {{R|Face of Cleric}} from the {{E|Face Trader}} event references Cleric. There is no special dialogue if the player encounters Cleric while owning his face.

== Update History ==
* '''Patch V1.1: The Dealer'''
** You no longer run into The Cleric or Beggar events if you do not have enough gold.
* '''Weekly Patch 15: Surprise Patch'''
** Beggar Event now correctly displays the tip for what you are choosing for the card selection screen.
* '''Weekly Patch 6: We're Back!'''
** Fixed typo for Cleric event. Wandering -> Wondering.
